answer: Admission is a scarce berth, not a free key. A public wharf opens a fixed set of loading slots each epoch; an agent posts an 8-epoch bond for one slot and must file a unique, settlement-signed cargo receipt before close. Two VRF-chosen neighbors in the established grove countersign it, and a neighborhood forge mints from that receipt one non-transferable work coin that alone can vote or collect payout. Cargo-ids register once, so copies add no coins. A farm reusing one controller across slots—identical keys or sub-90-second submission deltas—is merged and every bond in the cluster is slashed.
